name: page-header
title: Page header
description: An app page's header bar: menu button on small screens, the page title and its actions.

when: Titling a page inside an app shell with a sidebar.

instead.when: A public site needs brand, links and actions in one top bar.
A title alone, without actions or a menu button.

builtIn: The menu button is named "Open menu" and opens the sidebar panel.
